note: Game Reference Gate (v3): per-Q1 design traceability. reference_games are the proven games whose PRINCIPLES (not skins) each Q1 borrows; chain = JOB DIFFICULTY -> PRINCIPLE -> MECHANIC -> PLAYER ACTION -> WORLD FEEDBACK -> MASTERY. Sources: factory/taxonomy/mechanics-library.json evidence_games.

borrowed_design_principles: document-vs-object inspection under a mistake budget
one-item-at-a-time judgment queue with hidden violations
transformed_for_job: passport rules -> today's collection rules (day type rotates)
contraband -> hazardous items (spray cans/batteries) with a mechanical fire consequence
stamp choices -> load / violation sticker / bag sticker / hazard call
curb_check.why_it_is_fun: each bag is a small whodunit against a rotating rulebook; the street strip fills up with your calls and mistakes stay visible
curb_check.what_requires_skill: cross-referencing bag look with today's rules; knowing when NOT to load
curb_check.why_replay: bags, day type and violations re-randomize; perfect run = zero mistakes
curb_check.trace: hazard/irreversibility -> inspection-queue principle -> measurement_inspection -> per-bag 4-way call -> the street strip changes (bag lands in truck bed / stays stickered / waits for the hazard team; a wrong call gets a visible ❗ mark; loading a hazard puts 🔥 on the bed and ends the day) -> fewer mistakes per street

borrowed_design_principles: spatial resource juggling under throughput pressure
keep a system balanced, not a single task done
transformed_for_job: kitchen orders -> incoming waste loads of differing wetness
plate delivery -> feeding the incinerator a HOMOGENEOUS mix (850C rationale)
pit_crane.why_it_is_fun: grid juggling: every turn the pit changes, and greedy feeding backfires
pit_crane.what_requires_skill: reading the 3x3 grid state and mixing BEFORE feeding
pit_crane.why_replay: load sequences re-randomize; expert = stable burn all 8 turns
pit_crane.trace: fuel homogeneity duty -> spatial juggling principle -> spatial_placement/resource_allocation -> mix/feed choices on a grid -> grid cells + burn meter shift -> stable-burn streaks

borrowed_design_principles: evidence elimination under a hard time budget
asking the RIGHT authority matters more than acting fast
transformed_for_job: cross-examination -> instrument checks (calibration/tank/furnace/filter)
wrong accusation -> wrong team dispatched while the real cause reaches the stack
gas_watch.why_it_is_fun: a 3-suspect mystery where every check costs a time slot
gas_watch.what_requires_skill: choosing checks that SPLIT the remaining causes (information value)
gas_watch.why_replay: cause and meter values re-randomize; expert = 2-check triage
gas_watch.trace: alert triage duty -> elimination-under-time principle -> evidence_elimination + time budget -> check picks then one request -> time pips burn, cause chips strike out -> 2-check mastery

borrowed_design_principles: persistent duties compete with throughput
small daily choices compound into system health
transformed_for_job: line expansion -> cell allocation for typed intake (ash/incombustible)
nightly covering duty + leachate tank as the compounding system
landfill_ops.why_it_is_fun: a tiny management sim: today's shortcuts visibly bite tomorrow
landfill_ops.what_requires_skill: placement concentration (less exposed face) + weather-aware cover priority
landfill_ops.why_replay: intake + weather re-randomize; expert = 5 clean days, low complaints
landfill_ops.trace: duty-vs-throughput -> compounding-sim principle -> resource_allocation -> place loads + choose covers -> cells fill, tank/complaint meters move -> clean-week mastery

borrowed_design_principles: daily judgment against slowly drifting data
care loop where overreaction is a real error class
transformed_for_job: document stamps -> ok/adjust/consult triage from the growth CURVE + diary
pet care -> professional husbandry: single dips are noise, patterns are signal
baby_care.why_it_is_fun: reading a living curve like a detective: is today noise or signal?
baby_care.what_requires_skill: trend-vs-single-number discrimination; combining curve shape with diary flags
baby_care.why_replay: 12+ week layouts, benign dips punish panic; perfect week = 5/5 calls
baby_care.trace: trend triage duty -> daily-judgment principle -> trend_reading -> 3-way call each morning -> curve grows + mentor nudge on miss -> mistake-free weeks

borrowed_design_principles: evidence elimination with cost-weighted probes
last-resort actions carry real risk
transformed_for_job: testimony -> low-burden observations (diary/camera/feces)
final accusation -> one-shot treatment plan; restraint = 12% aborted day, gated behind 2 observations
zoo_checkup.why_it_is_fun: diagnosing without touching: burden budget makes every probe a real choice
zoo_checkup.what_requires_skill: choosing checks that change the plan; burden economy
zoo_checkup.why_replay: 3 causes re-randomize; expert = diagnosis at burden <=1
zoo_checkup.trace: low-burden ladder -> cost-weighted elimination -> evidence_elimination + resource_budget -> pick checks then one plan -> burden bar fills, cause chips die -> burden-1 mastery

borrowed_design_principles: assemble orders against a spec under resource constraints
the spec interacts with today's tickets (no memorized answer)
transformed_for_job: recipes -> the daily ration table applied to TODAY's weigh-in and nursing memo
limited ingredients -> veg stock arithmetic with lactation priority
feed_prep.why_it_is_fun: a pantry puzzle where the same table yields a different correct breakfast every morning
feed_prep.what_requires_skill: rule x data derivation + stock counting + priority reasoning
feed_prep.why_replay: weigh-in straddles the milk line, stock varies; perfect = zero redos
feed_prep.trace: rules-x-data duty -> spec-assembly principle -> rule_application + resource_budget -> tray building -> trays fill, senior silently points at a wrong tray -> first-serve mastery

borrowed_design_principles: plan under uncertainty, then adapt to live events
withdrawing can be the winning move, but must be justified
transformed_for_job: ship loadout -> debut plan derived from the practice record (expectation gate scales with it)
live crises -> crowd/noise slots + stress signs; levers counter DIFFERENT pressures; stop ladder enforced
debut_plan.why_it_is_fun: a tense little ops sim: watch the cub, pick the right lever, dare to stop
debut_plan.what_requires_skill: record-to-plan translation + pressure-matched lever choice + stop timing
debut_plan.why_replay: temperament and events re-randomize; perfect = fitting plan with calm day or justified early stop
debut_plan.trace: welfare-first ops -> plan-then-adapt principle -> plan_then_adapt + event_response -> plan sliders + per-slot actions -> cub drifts to hide box, sign lamps light, crowd icons -> lever-matching mastery

borrowed_design_principles: place now for retrieval later (spatial lookahead)
the cost of a bad layout arrives visibly at rush time
transformed_for_job: warehouse tiles -> container stacks with pickup days
rush hour -> the dawn discharge simulation replaying your choices
yard_plan.why_it_is_fun: a compact stacking puzzle where tomorrow morning replays your decisions box by box
yard_plan.what_requires_skill: reading the whole manifest and keeping columns sorted by pickup
yard_plan.why_replay: ship contents and pickup days re-randomize; perfect = zero rehandles
yard_plan.trace: retrieval-order duty -> spatial-lookahead principle -> spatial_placement -> place 8 boxes -> dawn sim moves boxes aside with ❗ per rehandle -> zero-rehandle mastery

borrowed_design_principles: per-case judgment against posted regulations
withdrawing/stopping as a first-class winning move
transformed_for_job: passport rules -> port wind/lock/signal regulations
ship crisis -> gusts, unseated locks, mismatched ground cues
crane_lift.why_it_is_fun: a tense gauge-reading loop where restraint is the skill
crane_lift.what_requires_skill: mapping instrument state to the regulation ladder; not over-stopping
crane_lift.why_replay: wind/lock/cue patterns re-randomize; perfect = no strikes, no needless holds
crane_lift.trace: safety-over-speed duty -> justified-restraint principle -> pressure_matched_response -> 4-way call per lift -> gauges move, boxes accumulate, red lamps on strikes -> clean-night mastery

borrowed_design_principles: document-vs-reality cross-checking under a mistake budget
neutral recording as the professional core
transformed_for_job: passport fields -> container number(check digit)/seal/condition
approve-deny -> accept/query-number/query-seal/record-damage + fair wording
tally_check.why_it_is_fun: spot-the-difference with real stakes: your record is the proof
tally_check.what_requires_skill: three-point matching; restraint from asserting WHEN damage happened
tally_check.why_replay: numbers/seals/damage re-randomize; perfect = five clean calls
tally_check.trace: handover-proof duty -> cross-check principle -> measurement_inspection -> per-box 4-way call + wording -> gate strip fills, wrong calls carry ❗ -> no-miss mastery

borrowed_design_principles: hard network constraints shape every assignment
chaining nearby tasks is the optimization layer
transformed_for_job: lines/stations -> chassis types, road height limits, booked windows
order chaining -> pairing nearby destinations to cut empty runs
truck_dispatch.why_it_is_fun: a small assignment puzzle where the map, the truck and the clock all bite
truck_dispatch.what_requires_skill: satisfying hard constraints first, then minimizing empty runs
truck_dispatch.why_replay: job mixes re-randomize; perfect = first-serve with empty-run <= 1
truck_dispatch.trace: road-legality duty -> constrained-assignment principle -> resource_allocation -> job->truck taps -> trucks visibly load, checker points at a wrong truck -> low-empty-run mastery

borrowed_design_principles: curate what REMAINS, not what you remove
quota by weighted value, not by count
transformed_for_job: inventory tiles -> a stand of trees with volume weights
zoning balance -> wind-lane and future-tree constraints
thinning_pick.why_it_is_fun: a subtraction puzzle where the answer is the forest you leave behind, with a 5-years-later reveal
thinning_pick.what_requires_skill: volume arithmetic + damage triage + spatial spacing
thinning_pick.trace: volume-rate duty -> curation principle -> spatial selection -> mark/unmark trees -> meter moves, trees gray out, 5-year preview -> first-serve mastery

borrowed_design_principles: mandatory procedure order enforced by the world
handing off to specialists is a correct move, not a fail
transformed_for_job: courtroom order -> signal->escape-check->cut
ship retreat -> winch-team handoff for impossible trees
fell_direction.why_it_is_fun: spatial one-shots with a falling-tree payoff animation and a real dare-to-delegate choice
fell_direction.what_requires_skill: lean x obstacle x escape reading; procedure discipline
fell_direction.why_replay: leans/obstacles re-randomize; perfect = no red whistles, no wasted handoffs
fell_direction.trace: felling-safety duty -> procedure+delegation principle -> justified_refusal + spatial call -> signal then direction tap -> tree falls (CSS), logs line up, red whistle on unsafe -> clean-day mastery

borrowed_design_principles: a budget that cannot cover everything forces priority judgment
crops must match the tile, not the player's favorite
transformed_for_job: heat allocation -> deer-guard budget across zones
crop tiles -> species x moisture fit on a real slope
plant_plan.why_it_is_fun: a tight 3-zone allocation puzzle with a 3-years-later germination reveal
plant_plan.what_requires_skill: fit matrix + protecting the RIGHT zone under budget
plant_plan.why_replay: moisture/deer patterns re-randomize; perfect = all zones alive, first serve
plant_plan.trace: regeneration duty -> scarcity-allocation principle -> resource_budget + matching -> per-zone species/guard picks -> hillside preview (growing vs eaten) -> first-serve mastery

reference_games: Return of the Obra Dinn (deduction from evidence placement)
borrowed_design_principles: truth is located WHERE the evidence changes, not what one clue says
spending limited probes where they split hypotheses
transformed_for_job: deduction board -> river spots up/downstream of a plant and a tributary
limited probes -> four sampling bottles
water_trace.why_it_is_fun: a reverse-whodunit about GOOD news, with a stocking-poster red herring
water_trace.what_requires_skill: choosing spots that split the three truths; refusing one-sighting conclusions
water_trace.why_replay: causes/readings re-randomize; expert = correct with 3 bottles
water_trace.trace: comparison-survey duty -> evidence-gradient principle -> evidence_elimination(spatial) -> pick spots + conclude -> meters plant flags on the river band, truth zone sparkles -> few-bottle mastery

borrowed_design_principles: throughput follows demand, not maximum
the system is a living thing with a mood
transformed_for_job: kitchen rush -> inflow load incl. a forecast rain surge
pet mood -> microbe face + bubble intensity + power waste meter
plant_ops.why_it_is_fun: keeping an invisible creature happy with one dial — where MORE is a real trap
plant_ops.what_requires_skill: matching air to load each slot; anticipating the rain slot
plant_ops.why_replay: load curves re-randomize; perfect = zero troubles AND zero wasted power
plant_ops.trace: aeration duty -> demand-matching principle -> parameter_adjust -> up/keep/down per slot -> bubbles/face/DO needle/power meter react -> zero-waste mastery

borrowed_design_principles: the best plan uses the FEWEST interventions that satisfy hard constraints
every over-build has a visible ecological cost
transformed_for_job: minimal lines -> minimal armoring (必要最小限)
zoning -> per-reach work choice + a fishway for the weir
bank_design.why_it_is_fun: a subtraction design puzzle: the win is what you DON'T build, shown by a 3-years river preview
bank_design.what_requires_skill: reading which reaches truly need protection; nature-score optimization
bank_design.why_replay: erosion/backland patterns re-randomize; perfect = pass with nature score >= 4
bank_design.trace: minimal-armoring duty -> restraint-design principle -> resource_budget + matching -> per-reach work picks -> preview shows fish climbing / riffles returning -> high-nature mastery

reference_games: Her Story (cross-referencing fragments into one truth)
borrowed_design_principles: one striking match is a trap; independent corroboration is the win condition
the ANSWER has two layers: what you claim and how sure you may claim it
transformed_for_job: case files -> old maps/rosters/photo ledgers of a local-history room
confidence system -> レファレンスの確定/推定 answer rule (3+/2 matches)
photo_clues.why_it_is_fun: a real detective loop where the twist is HONESTY: 推定 is sometimes the perfect answer
photo_clues.what_requires_skill: spending 4 lookups where they discriminate candidates; resisting the lookalike decoy; choosing the right certainty
photo_clues.why_replay: answer/decoy/match-pattern re-randomize; expert = right place AND right certainty first try
photo_clues.world_feedback: 照合ボードに一致/不一致ピンが立ち、誤答は付せん付きで紙が戻る

reference_games: House Flipper cleaning mode (satisfying per-item care)
borrowed_design_principles: the rulebook makes refusal a skill: some actions must NOT be taken
per-item diagnosis -> one deliberate action, visible shelf progress
transformed_for_job: inspection rules -> conservation ethics (no tape/laminate/peel, mold quarantine)
the twist: 'do nothing but record' is a correct professional treatment
paper_rescue.why_it_is_fun: the urge to FIX collides with the pro rule that fixing destroys; the senior's hand stopping yours is a world reaction
paper_rescue.what_requires_skill: reading each item's condition; restraint on fine/old-taped items; instant quarantine on mold
paper_rescue.why_replay: item mix shuffles; expert = zero mistakes with restraint choices
paper_rescue.world_feedback: 保存箱が1点ずつ埋まり、カビ品は🔒隔離表示。誤処置は机に残る

reference_games: PC Building Simulator work orders (spec-matching per order)
Cataloguing sims / Strange Horticulture (honest labeling under uncertainty)
borrowed_design_principles: specs derive from the PURPOSE of the order, not habit
uncertainty is data: recording 'unknown' correctly is rewarded
transformed_for_job: work order -> 保存用TIFF400dpi vs 閲覧用JPEG
label honesty -> 確定/推定/撮影地ふめい from carried-over evidence; rights hold for visible people
digi_archive.why_it_is_fun: the archive shelf fills with YOUR honest labels; the 100-years-later framing gives meaning
digi_archive.what_requires_skill: 3-part decision per item (spec×label×publish) with different sources of truth
digi_archive.world_feedback: 登録票が差し戻される/棚にサムネイルとラベルが並ぶ

borrowed_design_principles: change ONE variable per experiment; a differing outcome localizes the cause
a claim must be confirmed by a reproducing run, not inferred
transformed_for_job: logic puzzle -> QA test bench with condition toggles and a run budget
code guess -> 不具合票 filing that demands the minimal confirmed pair
bug_repro.why_it_is_fun: detective satisfaction of turning たまに into 必ず; the ✅/💥 log is the deduction board
bug_repro.what_requires_skill: experiment design within 6 runs; resisting filing early or fat reports
bug_repro.why_replay: the crashing pair re-randomizes; expert = file in 6 runs, zero bounces
bug_repro.world_feedback: run log stamps ✅/💥; bounced tickets return with a specific sticky note

reference_games: Game Dev Story (tuning loop, honest numbers)
borrowed_design_principles: numbers point at WHERE and HOW players fail, not just how often
the obvious lever (nerf HP) is usually the wrong one
transformed_for_job: pattern reading -> playlog evidence lines mapped to 4 causes
wrong lever -> retest numbers that refuse to move
difficulty_tune.why_it_is_fun: being the one who explains WHY it felt too hard; the clear-rate bar moves when you're right
difficulty_tune.what_requires_skill: matching evidence to cause; ignoring the HP-nerf reflex
difficulty_tune.why_replay: 2 causes drawn from 4 re-randomize; expert = zero failed retests
difficulty_tune.world_feedback: clear-rate bars animate on success; a wrong fix leaves them frozen

reference_games: I'm on Observation Duty (spotting what's wrong on a screen)
borrowed_design_principles: a live mock that visibly changes with each decision
constraints (3 picks) force prioritization instead of adding everything
transformed_for_job: spot-the-issue -> 3 randomized test reports mapped 1:1 to fixes
constraint -> UI rule: adding clutters; decoys actively worsen the mock
ui_clarity.why_it_is_fun: the mock screen improves (or degrades!) live as you toggle fixes
ui_clarity.why_replay: 3 of 5 reports drawn per case; expert = first-try pass
ui_clarity.world_feedback: mock updates live; testers point at the unanswered report
